Thanks — reviewed the draft. Suggested adjustments: 

1) Consolidated commit line-item: create a single monthly dollar commit mapped to a composite SKU that represents weighted usage across generation and embeddings. This avoids two separate invoice lines and simplifies GCP marketplace billing.

2) Smoothing approach: implement a 2-tier smoothing policy —
   - Buffer reserve: 5% of monthly commit held as "buffer" to accommodate spikes (released monthly)
   - Carryover: unspent dollars in months 1-3 can be carried forward but must be rebalanced by month 6. Any carryover > 25% triggers a midterm usage review.

3) Invoice cadence: default monthly invoices with an option to provide quarterly amortized statements for internal accounting. For Marketplace private offers, we typically submit monthly consumption reports to GCP to reconcile drawdown.

I attached a short mapping table in the draft spreadsheet and added comments where Orbit should supply SKU names. From a finance ops perspective we also need Orbit's tax and billing address for the PO.
